subject: Caleb Torres — adjudication playbook and tiebreak recommendation
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: SmartHire Agency <recruiting@smarthire.co>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Caleb Torres — adjudication playbook and initial scores

Team —

Thanks for taking the time on Caleb's loop. Attached is the consolidated scorecard export from the panel (caleb_torres_scorecard.pdf) and a short doc with raw notes (link below). We have a split across two dimensions: technical depth (avg 4.0/5) and systems design (avg 3.2/5). There isn't a clear majority on hire/no-hire, so we need to: 

- Capture missing evidence from interviews (who has the strongest justification for 4/5 vs 3/5)
- Decide tiebreak rule (defer to hiring manager, majority vote, or neutral chair)
- Lock a recommended path for recruiter to proceed (offer / rej / hold) by EOD Friday so the candidate timeline isn't stalled

Please reply inline with: 1) your final vote (hire/hold/no-hire), 2) 2–3 bullet justification tied to rubric anchors, and 3) whether you want to ask for a short follow-up with Caleb (10–20m) focused on the single gap area.

Drive: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-Caleb-Torres-panel-notes
Greenhouse: https://greenhouse.io/score/CalebTorres

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Eng Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: caleb_torres_scorecard.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Caleb Torres — adjudication playbook and initial scores

On Wed, Sep 1, 2027 at 09:12 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Thanks for taking the time on Caleb's loop...

Quick notes and my vote: HIRE (lean).

Why:
- Technical depth: demonstrated clear KVM/cache reasoning in the systems question (tied to rubric anchor: const-time cache invalidation).
- Communication: structured answers and iterated on feedback during whiteboard follow-up.
- Risk: systems design gap is narrow and addressable in ramp; we can pair on an initial intern-style project to validate.

I attached my panel note highlights (panel_notes.docx) — see the "cache tradeoffs" snippet. If we need a tie-breaker, I'm okay delegating to Jonas as hiring manager. No follow-up with Caleb needed from my side.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Staff SWE | Redwood Inference

Attachment: panel_notes.docx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Caleb Torres — adjudication playbook and initial scores

Vanessa / team —

Thanks for pulling this together. My vote: HOLD (concern).

Why:
- Systems design: Caleb's approach to multi-tenant isolation left assumptions about KV lifecycles that weren't challenged (rubric anchor: fault-tolerance reasoning).
- Evidence: I didn't hear a concrete rollback strategy; that felt like an omission on the primary question.

Proposal: If Jonas (hiring manager) prefers to move forward, I suggest a 15-minute clarifying call with Caleb focused solely on that rollback/failure scenario; if he cannot demonstrate a concise rollback plan, we should pass. I can host the call and ask the direct question.

Tessa Morgan
Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Caleb Torres — adjudication playbook and initial scores

Team —

Appreciate the notes. My position: HIRE with a short contingency (paired ramp week + design checklist). Rationale: Caleb's product sense and low-level systems intuition are strong; the rollback detail is a teachable gap and we have capacity in Q4 for a short convergence project.

I'll take the tiebreak in this case. Next steps for recruiter (SmartHire): prepare an offer with standard comp band A, start date target 2027-10-03, and include a 90-day design checklist we can use to validate. Copy below is what I want in the offer packet:
- Role: Senior SWE (Systems)
- Comp band: Band A (range attached in internal HR link)
- Contingency: successful completion of a 90-day checklist to validate fault-tolerance deliverables; no effect on comp, just for onboarding sign-off.

Also attaching the final score summary for record (final-scorecard.xlsx). I'll update Greenhouse after we confirm the offer path.

Jonas Weber
Director of Engineering | Redwood Inference

Attachment: final-scorecard.xlsx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: SmartHire Agency <recruiting@smarthire.co>
Date: 2027-09-03T16:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Caleb Torres — adjudication playbook and initial scores

Thanks all —

I'm aligned with Jonas. Marissa and Tessa, thank you for the detailed anchors — those are in the shared doc. SmartHire, please proceed to prepare the offer materials per Jonas's outline and send tentative timelines by EOD Monday. I'll update GH and move the candidate to "offer approved" once we have the packet.

One ask for the record: everyone, please drop one-line evidence bullets into the Drive doc under the "Final justification" header (so TA and HR have explicit rubrics to defend the hire). Link again: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-Caleb-Torres-panel-notes

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Eng Manager | Redwood Inference
